page.overview:
Who is Giichi Tomioka?

Giichi bears a great resemblance to his ancestor, Giyu. He also has a pale complexion and choppy raven-black, neck-length hair. His haircut is similar to his ancestor's after the battle with Muzan Kibutsuji. His eyes are moderately large, framed by thin eyebrows. The irises a dark blue that fades to a lighter blue with their pupils being bluish-black.

He wears a blue sweater, a pair of black jogging pants with a red stripe on each side, and a black backpack.

Unlike his ancestor Giyu's stoic personality, Giichi seems to be cheerful and happy, especially with his best friends. He also appears to be a generous person, offering his toy charm to his friend when he sees how happy it would make her.

Giichi is with his two best friends from the swimming school walking on the streets, when Sumihiko Kamado runs past them on his way to school.
